forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1MP0MQ6VHRR004FQQEADS6C
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'Exit codes: one table for every stop reason and failure'
+---
+## What
+
+cli-plan.md §5.8. "Nonzero" is not enough for a script. Add
+`Sources/acp-agent/ExitCode.swift` with one enum, and use it everywhere
+the CLI exits.
+
+| Code | Meaning |
+|---|---|
+| 0 | `end_turn`, or a report that ran |
+| 1 | An error: configuration, spawn, protocol, or I/O. `doctor` found an error. |
+| 2 | A usage error |
+| 3 | `refusal` |
+| 4 | `cancelled` |
+| 5 | `doctor` found warnings, and no error |
+| 124 | A timeout, which is the `timeout(1)` convention |
+
+Code 5 exists because the Rust `sah doctor` uses 2 for errors, and 2 is
+our usage error. A script would otherwise read a broken configuration as
+a typing mistake. See `doctor-plan.md` §5.
+
+Map each `StopReason` of the wire to its code in one total switch, so a
+new stop reason in the wire package makes the build fail rather than
+silently exiting 0. ArgumentParser raises its own usage error; make it
+exit 2 through `CommandConfiguration` or an `exit(withError:)` wrapper.
+
+The reason line goes to **stderr**, never to stdout.
+
+- [ ] `ExitCode.swift`, with the seven cases
+- [ ] A total switch over `StopReason`
+- [ ] The ArgumentParser usage error maps to 2
+- [ ] Every exit path in `Run` and `Acp` uses the enum
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A scripted `end_turn` gives 0, `refusal` gives 3, `cancelled`
+      gives 4.
+- [ ] An unknown flag gives 2, with stdout empty.
+- [ ] A configuration that fails to load gives 1, with the reason on
+      stderr.
+- [ ] The `StopReason` switch is total: it has no `default` case.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ExitCodeTests.swift`: one
+      assertion per row of the table, driven through the scripted model
+      where a stop reason is necessary.
+- [ ] A test asserts that stdout is empty for each nonzero exit.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
